_comment: Playlist schema. Daemon reloads on change; new order takes effect at the next transition, never mid-air. Files live in media/ next to this file. Optional per item: source (URL/path for prefetch to resolve), show (series tag for similar-replacement), status (active|dormant; dormant keeps its link but never airs), pinned (true = never evicted, never auto-replaced). Dormant + pinned items are the archive the operator curates; active unpinned items are the rotation the cache manages.
